propositions: pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main due to PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability in click 8.2.1, blocking Verified +1 votes.
click is a transitive dependency pinned at 8.2.1 in uv.lock; the vulnerable code path (click.edit()) is unreachable in rebar, and the advisory applies only to direct click consumers.
inspect-ai (via [eval] extra) caps click below 8.2.2 across all released versions, making a lock bump to 8.3.3+ impossible without overriding the upstream constraint.
uv resolves all extras jointly, so constraint-dependencies cannot lift inspect-ai's cap; override-dependencies is the correct tool to replace the requirement.

The cap is stale: inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports and executes cleanly under click 8.4.2, confirming no real incompatibility; the fix applies override-dependencies to move click to 8.4.2 while upstream relaxes its constraints.
